reason: WorkPage composes one current-client, read-only Strategy view: successful summaries select the exact detail observers, completeness selects aggregate counts, and the same verified details feed the cards, upcoming work, risks and canonical links. Native validation/projection remain in contracts.ts and query keys/cancellation in queries.ts. WorkStrategyState owns the error/unavailable presentation and derives initial-error retry feedback from current observer status, without adding stored error, cache, editor or mutation state. WorkspaceDocuments separately owns the three-read legacy document association gate and now delegates its responsive table rendering to WorkspaceDocumentTable. The remaining WorkPage body is the composition of those coupled projections; another extraction solely for its line count would not separate an unrelated responsibility.
